contract: bundle contract v1.6 (stored JSON manifests; effective hash over stored manifest bytes)
source: dreamlake-ai/dreamlake-workspace feat/bundle-corpus@5332a7b1 fixtures/bundles (stored form via tools/corpus.py emit)
notes: Hashes are sha256:<lowercase hex>. Preimages are base64.
dir line = <name> NUL <f|d> NUL <child hex> LF, children sorted by UTF-8 bytes of name.
A tree is a set of file paths; empty directories (emptyDirs) are not in it.
A dir prefix that is missing or names a file hashes to emptyHash.
effective = sha256('entry' NUL <manifest file hex> LF + uses lines in declared order + ref lines sorted by UTF-8 bytes of the canonical ref ns/b@W#e, W = displayed version).
Ref lines use resolvedRefs; the server resolves refs against the referenced bundle history. A local ref '#e' (same bundle version) has the canonical string '#e'.
bundles[].versions[].files list path, sha256 and size; the bytes are in blobs (sha256 -> base64).
jsonc: source-manifest parse parity (value or error). storedForm: source -> stored bytes (JSON.stringify(sortKeys(v), null, 2) + LF); Python output, check with Node.
manifestBytes: one value in three byte forms gives three effective hashes; only storedForm bytes are accepted in a bundle version.
